node.label: Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome
node.definition: Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome (AGS) is an inherited, subacute encephalopathy characterized by the association of basal ganglia calcification, leukodystrophy and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) lymphocytosis.
synonyms: encephalopathy with intracranial calcification and chronic lymphocytosis of cerebrospinal fluid
encephalopathy, familial infantile, with calcification of basal ganglia and chronic cerebrospinal fluid lymphocytosis
